questions.title: 钦佩的运动员
questions.text:
Describe a successful sportsperson you admire
You should say:
Who he/she is
What you know about him/her
What he/she is like in real life
What achievement he/she has made
questions.english:
A successful sportsperson I admire is Ma Long, the Chinese table tennis player. I know him mainly through sports news and videos of international competitions.

He has won Olympic gold medals and major international titles, so his achievements are impressive even to someone who doesn't follow every match. What interests me most is that success in table tennis depends on quick reactions and careful decisions, not just physical strength.

I don't know him personally, so my impression of his life outside competition comes from interviews and other public appearances. He seems calm, disciplined, and serious about improving. On the court, he can change his approach when an opponent creates a new problem, which makes his matches interesting to watch.

The quality I admire is his ability to stay focused under pressure. A strong player still makes mistakes, but has to move on immediately rather than let one point affect the next. That is relevant to study and research too. I wouldn't compare my work directly with elite sport, but his patience and consistency offer a useful example of how progress requires more than a brief period of enthusiasm.
questions.chinese:
我钦佩的一位成功运动员是中国乒乓球选手马龙。我主要通过体育新闻和国际比赛的视频了解他。

他赢得过奥运金牌和重要国际赛事的冠军，所以即使是不关注每一场比赛的人，也会对他的成就印象深刻。我最感兴趣的是，乒乓球比赛中的成功依靠快速反应和谨慎决策，而不仅仅是体力。

我并不认识他本人，所以我对他赛场外生活的印象来自采访和其他公开活动。他看起来冷静、自律，也很认真地追求进步。在场上，当对手带来新的难题时，他能够调整打法，这使他的比赛很有看头。

我钦佩的是他在压力下保持专注的能力。实力很强的选手同样会犯错，但必须马上调整，不能让上一分影响下一分。这一点对学习和研究也有启发。我不会把自己的工作直接与顶尖竞技运动相比，但他的耐心和坚持提供了一个有用的例子：进步需要的不只是短暂的热情。
pending: 马龙的冠军成就是笼统公开背景；用户是否关注、看过采访、钦佩及具体感受均为候选；不写私人认识关系。

questions.title: 喜欢的公共建筑
questions.text:
Describe a public building you enjoy visiting (e.g. a library, a shopping mall, a sports
hall, etc.)
You should say:
Where it is
How you knew it
What it looks like
And explain why you enjoy visiting it
questions.english:
A public building I enjoyed visiting is the Musikverein in Vienna, which is especially famous for its Golden Hall. I visited the Golden Hall during my solo trip to Europe in June, when I also attended an academic conference.

Before the trip, I came across it in an online guide to Vienna. I learned it was one of the city's famous cultural landmarks and wanted to include it while exploring the city. The building has an elegant, traditional appearance, with a sense of symmetry and decorative detail that feels quite different from a modern office block.

What appeals to me is the atmosphere. The warm colours and careful design make it feel like a place created for people to pay attention and appreciate something together. Even focusing on the building itself gives me a connection to the city's musical culture.

I stayed in Vienna longer than in Budapest, so Vienna became the main place I would recommend from that trip. The Golden Hall is part of the reason: it represents the cultural side of the city in a very concrete way. I study technology, but I still enjoy seeing how architecture and the arts shape a place's identity.
questions.chinese:
我喜欢参观的公共建筑是维也纳音乐协会大楼，尤其以金色大厅闻名。今年六月，我独自去欧洲参加学术会议，旅行期间参观了金色大厅。

旅行前，我在一篇维也纳的网上旅游攻略里看到了它。我了解到它是这座城市著名的文化地标之一，便想在游览城市时去看看。建筑外观优雅而传统，对称的布局和装饰细节与现代办公楼很不一样。

吸引我的是那里的氛围。温暖的色彩和精心的设计，让人感觉这是一个可以专注欣赏、与他人共同感受艺术的地方。即使只是观察建筑本身，也能让我感受到这座城市的音乐文化。

我在维也纳停留的时间比布达佩斯更长，所以这次旅行中，我最想推荐的地方是维也纳。金色大厅也是原因之一：它让这座城市的文化特色变得具体可感。虽然我研究的是技术，但我也喜欢观察建筑与艺术如何塑造一个地方独有的风貌。
pending: 真实金色大厅参观、六月欧洲独行和维也纳停留较久已确认；旅行前通过网上攻略得知、建筑细节及喜爱感受为授权候选。没有在此听音乐会的事实，不加写音乐会。

questions.text: Is it easier to become popular nowadays?
questions.english: It is easier to reach a large audience now because social media allows people to share content quickly. A useful or entertaining post can spread beyond someone's usual circle. questions.text: What are the qualities of being a good teacher?
questions.english: A good teacher understands the subject and can explain it clearly at different levels. Patience matters because students won't all understand at the same speed. They should also listen, give useful feedback, and encourage questions. Being supportive doesn't mean avoiding standards; a strong teacher helps students meet those standards without making them afraid to admit confusion or mistakes.

questions.text: Do you think good teachers are always popular among students?

questions.text: Is talent important in sports?
questions.english: Talent can make certain movements or techniques easier to learn, particularly at a competitive level. But it doesn't remove the need for practice, discipline, and good coaching. A talented athlete who rarely trains may be overtaken by someone more consistent. For ordinary people, the main value of sport is participation and health, so exceptional natural ability shouldn't be a requirement.

questions.title: 喜欢的公共建筑
questions.text: Why do people visit historic buildings?
questions.english: Historic buildings give people a physical connection to the past. Their design and materials can reveal how earlier generations lived or what they valued. Some visitors also enjoy the beauty and atmosphere. Reading about a place is useful, but standing in the actual space can make its history feel more concrete and encourage questions that a textbook might not raise.
questions.chinese: 历史建筑让人与过去产生实物联系。设计材料能透露前人如何生活、重视什么。有些访客也享受美与氛围。阅读地点资料有用，但站在真实空间，让历史更具体，也引出教科书未必提出的问题。
